summary: The unit release is seven levels deep and the most derived class contributes no destructor body: 00CFC3D0 slot 0 (006FE570) calls 0081F3A0, which rewrites the LEVEL-5 vptr set 00D096xx that 0081ED40 installs. The four unread levels are 0081F3A0 (level 5), 00959940 (level 4), 0087A410 (level 3) and 0077E380 (level 2); 009287B0 and 00925780 are docs/ENTITY_LIFECYCLE_TAILS.md. No level releases the weapon director at +738h, the gunnery pass at +6DCh or the damage-state instance at +360h, and no level removes a spatial-index node. The recon detection records at +1E8h are dropped by level 2's last step. No level nils the Lua self table. entity+70h is read once, by level 2, as the payload of a kind-4Fh session message. player+8h's producer is 004BB47D in BSP_Game_ClaimParticipantRecord 004BB440; player+9h has no writer in the image.

The real body runs to the plain RET at 0081f8ad and holds levels 5's steps 11 to 23 (the +BD0h vptr store, the critical section at +BD4h, the eight ref slots +BC0h..+BA4h, the three eh-vector arrays, the repair task at +A20h, the four ref slots +9F4h..+9E8h, the +758h buffer, +74Ch, the +72Ch ref slot and the CALL 00959940). The integrator's earlier repair closed two internal gaps (the listing is now 120 consecutive instructions) but not this tail one.
ADD ESP,4; CMP dword ptr [ESI+0x428],EBX; JNE 00959a43 - the drain loop's back-edge. Without it the +428h list looks like a single-node unlink.
ADD ESP,4; CMP dword ptr [EDI],EBX; JNE 00959aa4 - the same for the twelve gun-category lists at +394h.
Ghidra's body for the level-2 destructor ends at 0077e441. The real body runs to the plain RET at 0077e490 and holds steps 4's tail, 5, 6 and the CALL 009287b0.
